item.title: Casual Talking Camera Testimonial

exact_text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical testimonial-style ad for FitTrack. A fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home, talks to camera: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Friendly and casual, with matching captions. Use a made-up presenter, not a real customer.

item.tests: Checks delivery of a short scripted talking-camera ad with audible speech and accurate captions, rather than a silent portrait or unrelated montage.

answer_sheet.Platform and size: Vertical 9:16 for a social reel; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Presenter: A fictional woman in her thirties, filming herself at home; not a real customer.
answer_sheet.Script and captions: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
answer_sheet.Language, voice and mood: English, friendly and casual; specific accent is your call.

must_haves: One approximately 8-second vertical video shows a fictional adult woman addressing the camera in a home setting.
The complete supplied script is audible in English without omissions or added testimonial claims.
Readable captions reproduce the supplied script exactly and follow the speech.
The presenter visibly speaks rather than remaining a still image throughout.
The ad does not label the fictional presenter as a verified or real customer.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a testimonial-style ad for FitTrack, with someone talking directly to the camera. I’m hoping it feels approachable because fitness planning can seem a little intimidating to me. It should be 8 seconds long and vertical, and the presenter should be a fictional woman in her 30s filming herself at home. Have her say, “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Keep it friendly and casual, with matching captions, and use a made-up presenter rather than a real customer.

dialog.agent: Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.user: Yes, please use matching captions with these exact words: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” It’s for a vertical 9:16 social reel, and free-tier resolution is fine.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: An approachable, friendly, casual testimonial-style FitTrack social reel. A completely fictional woman in her 30s, not a real customer and not based on a real person, films herself at home in a comfortable naturally lit living room. Vertical selfie-phone framing, medium close-up, looking directly into the lens, relaxed casual everyday clothes, warm natural smile and small conversational gestures. One continuous shot, believable low-key smartphone footage rather than a polished fitness commercial. She speaks clearly in English, naturally and warmly, delivering this entire exact line within 8 seconds: "FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks." Synchronized speaking mouth movements. Spoken dialogue is the focus. Do not draw captions or other text into the video; matching captions will be added afterward.
